pages.main_text_excerpt:
We are a global leader in innovative technologies and services shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy. With approximately 6.9 billion euros in sales and 17,900 employees across 78 countries, the Wärtsilä strategy focuses on helping customers to continuously improve their environmental and economic performance. Wärtsilä is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki.
In marine, we are a global pioneer in power, propulsion, digital, and lifecycle solutions, helping our customers navigate decarbonisation with confidence.
In the energy sector, Wärtsilä is at the forefront of the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. Our businesses of Energy and Energy Storage help our customers to accelerate their decarbonisation journeys through our market-leading technologies and power system expertise.
In 2025, 26% of our net sales came from the Americas, 28% from Europe, 30% from Asia, and 16% from other parts of the world.

pages.title: This is Wärtsilä
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the world. Yet, today the marine and energy sectors generate over a third of global greenhouse gases.
Over 80% of world trade is carried by sea. And global electricity demand is on track to double by 2050.
That’s why at Wärtsilä, we’ve chosen to dedicate ourselves to shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy. We help our customers make a decarbonisation journey that is not just environmentally sustainable, but financially viable, too.
We already have most of the technology to decarbonise shipping and build a 100% renewable energy future. We develop engines that can run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels – such as ammonia, hydrogen and methanol. Our innovative technologies and services help our customers cut emissions, improve efficiency and reduce costs. Our engines and batteries on land ‘balance’ renewable energy by kicking in when the sun isn’t shining or wind isn’t blowing. This makes renewables more scalable and reliable.
But green is not black or white, and no single solution will carry us through the transition. Fossil fuels will play a role while sustainable alternatives become more available. As none of us alone have all the answers, we innovate along with our ecosystems and work to reduce global emissions while securing financial viability.
Explore the defining characteristics of our industries and what makes Wärtsilä well-positioned to support our customers in their decarbonisation journey.

pages.title: Careers at Wärtsilä
pages.main_text_excerpt:
We are Wärtsilä – one global team of purpose-driven experts committed to decarbonising the marine and energy industries. Operating under our leadership behaviours and core values of customer success, passion, and performance, we are united in shaping a sustainable future for societies.
Our story begun already in 1834, and it is one of transformation. This 190-year journey has been enabled by our innovations, our extraordinary ability to adapt to change, and most of all by our people. We are always on the look for bright minds to join our journey of decarbonising the marine and energy industries.
Want to unlock your personal growth opportunities and to make a lasting impact on society? Review our open positions or leave an open application by creating a candidate profile.
We are committed in complying with responsible business conduct, fair employment practices, anti-corruption policy and other commitments that you can find here.
We are a team of over 17,900 Wärtsilians in 78 countries across all seven continents. While representing 123 different nationalities and varying fields of expertise and job roles, we are united by the impact we make in enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services.

On our decarbonisation journey, understanding expectations and finding meaning in the work is essential. For this, we foster an open and transparent communication culture.
Based on our MyVoice employee engagement survey, Wärtsilä’s employee engagement index score is at 82%. This figure represents the percentage of employees who report being highly engaged with the company.
Wärtsilians consistently rate our relationships with managers and peers as exceptional. 88% of our respondents feel that they are treated with respect at work. Furthermore, 89% of our people feel that there is zero tolerance for any kind of discrimination and harassment at Wärtsilä.
MyVoice is our bi-annual global employee engagement survey, conducted last time in 2024. It has five KPIs: Engagement, Overall experience, Inclusion, Intent to stay, and Wellbeing. All MyVoice 2024 questions have a global external benchmark. In addition, we have more frequent employee listening pulses for global functions and businesses. Each time a survey is conducted, the findings are carefully analysed and actions are planned based on the results.
Wärtsilä’s purpose and values lay the foundation for our strategy. Our purpose – Enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services – defines why we exist as a company and guides the way forward: how everyone at Wärtsilä can make a difference for the world.
Wärtsilä values unite everyone in the company and bring the strategy to life by guiding our priorities, decision-making, and behaviour when working together in everyday situations.
How do our purpose and values resonate with you on a personal level? Embracing them could make you an outstanding fit for our dynamic and dedicated team, where we strive to make a lasting impact in the sustainability of our society.

Develop people and teams
We're committed to creating an environment where people can grow and perform at their best. Our leaders actively coach and empower their teams, recognize competence and experience, and invest time in developing both themselves and others as leaders.
Challenge and support change
Innovation thrives when we foster environments that welcome new ideas and learning from mistakes. Our leaders encourage continuous improvement, build environments of trust and feedback, and celebrate success together.
The Wärtsilä Leadership Model provides a common language for leadership and enables dialogue on specific leadership behaviors in different situations. We use this model to attract, develop and promote great leaders, and to evaluate leadership at both individual and organisational levels.
